content:
Let \(A=x^{\lg 7}\) and \(B=x^{\lg 5}\). Then

\[
7^{\lg x}-5^{\lg x+1}=3\cdot 5^{\lg x-1}-13\cdot 7^{\lg x-1}
\]

becomes

\[
A-5B=\frac35B-\frac{13}{7}A.
\]

So

\[
\frac{20}{7}A=\frac{28}{5}B
\quad\Rightarrow\quad
\frac{A}{B}=\frac{49}{25}.
\]

Since

\[
\frac{A}{B}=\frac{x^{\lg 7}}{x^{\lg 5}}=x^{\lg(7/5)},
\]

we get

\[
x^{\lg(7/5)}=\left(\frac75\right)^2.
\]

Taking \(\lg\) of both sides:

\[
\lg(7/5)\lg x=2\lg(7/5).
\]

Thus \(\lg x=2\), so

\[
\boxed{100}
\]
